policy.exact_key: black.lo u128le || black.hi u128le || white.lo u128le || white.hi u128le || side u8 (Black=0, White=1) || rule u8 (Freestyle=0)
policy.root_uid: uppercase SHA256 hex of ASCII "CB-P1-exact-root-v1", followed by one NUL byte, followed by exact_key bytes
policy.retention: retain the first raw row for each exact key in frozen input file order

retained_order_encoding: u64le retained_count; then, in retained first-occurrence order, fixed-size records of u64le raw_line (1-based) || 32 raw root_uid bytes decoded from hex || u8 side (Black=0, White=1); no separators
